teach.click_hint: Click for an explanation using this contract as the example
teach.contractNo.example: {{no}}: {{year}} is the start year, {{seq}} the sequence number at this company.
teach.contractNo.note: A contract gets its number when it is created and never changes it.
teach.customer.note: The customer who pays for this contract.
teach.locations.note: Where the work happens; a line belongs to one location or to the whole contract.
teach.type.note: The kind of work; you set the types per company under Contract types.
teach.status.DRAFT: not active yet, nothing is invoiced
teach.status.expired_because: Expired because the end date {{date}} has passed.
teach.status.note: Expired follows from the end date; the other three you choose yourself.
teach.dates.from_until: Applies from {{from}} up to and including {{until}}.
teach.dates.from_open: Applies from {{from}}, with no end date (open-ended).
teach.dates.note: The first billing period is the period the start date falls in.
teach.monthly.total: {{amount}} per month, added up from the lines of the revision in force:
teach.monthly.note: A quarterly or yearly amount is converted to a month here.
teach.yearly.total: {{amount}} per year: the sum of the billing periods in the year.
teach.yearly.note: Not always 12 × the monthly amount: a part period counts only its days.
teach.hours.total: {{hours}} hours per {{period}}, added up from the lines:
teach.hours.note: The hours budget of one billing period; it is compared with the hours worked.
teach.hoursPerYear.calc: {{hours}} hours per period × {{times}} periods = {{total}} hours per year.
teach.hoursPerYear.note: The hours budget of a whole year.
teach.projects.note: A line is one part of the agreement: what, where, how many hours, what amount.
teach.billingPeriod.MONTHLY: Monthly: one invoice per calendar month.
teach.billingPeriod.QUARTERLY: Quarterly: one invoice per calendar quarter (Jan–Mar, Apr–Jun, …).
teach.billingPeriod.YEARLY: Yearly: one invoice per calendar year.
teach.billingPeriod.note: How often an invoice comes; the next ones are listed above.
teach.billingDay.rule: Billing day {{day}}: every invoice is dated day {{day}} of the month.
teach.billingDay.example: For example: the invoice of {{date}} for {{period}}.
teach.billingDay.note: 1 to 28, so the day exists in every month.
teach.billingType.ADVANCE: In advance: the invoice goes out on day {{day}} of the period's first month — before the work.
teach.billingType.ARREARS: In arrears: the invoice goes out on day {{day}} of the month after the period — after the work.
teach.billingType.note: Whether the customer pays before or after the period the work is done in.
teach.paymentTerms.example: {{days}} days: an invoice of {{invoice}} must be paid before {{due}}.
teach.paymentTerms.note: How many days the customer has to pay.
teach.proration.on: On: a period that does not fall entirely within the contract counts only its days.
teach.proration.off: Off: every period is invoiced in full, the first and the last included.
teach.proration.starts: This contract starts on {{date}}; that first period would then be a part period.
teach.proration.note: Part period = a part of a billing period, pro rata by days.
teach.revision.note: A revision records what was agreed from a date onwards; what has already been invoiced stays.
teach.revisionState.planned: takes effect later and can be edited until that day
teach.forecast.rows: {{count}} invoices are still to come in {{year}}, {{total}} in total.
teach.forecast.note: Calculated from the agreement and the billing settings; nothing is created here.
teach.noneInForce.line: On {{today}} no revision is in force yet; the first takes effect on {{date}}.
teach.noneInForce.note: Until that day nothing is invoiced.
teach.invoicesPerYear.line: {{count}} invoices per year at one per {{period}}.
detail.unavailableBody: It could not be read for your account, or it no longer exists.
detail.noLinesTitle: This contract has no lines yet.
detail.noLinesDesc: A line is a service at a building for an amount per period.
detail.start_no_lines: This contract has no lines yet — a line is one service, one amount, one period.
detail.start_draft: Nothing is invoiced until this contract is activated.
detail.start_ending: This contract ends on {{date}} — decide what follows it.
projects.addNeedsName: Give the line a name first.
road.aria: A contract's road: draft, active, ending, ended
road.draft_body: A draft is an agreement being built: put the lines in (what, where, how much per period), then activate. Until then the invoices do not change.
road.draft_empty_body: A draft appears with New contract; it is only invoiced after you activate it.
road.active_body: These run and are invoiced per period. A change goes through a new revision, effective from its own date.
road.active_empty_body: Activate a draft and it appears here; from that moment it is invoiced per period.
road.ending_body: These contracts are running out. Decide the follow-up: a new end date, or let it end — invoicing then stops by itself.
road.ending_money_label: per month stops within 60 days ({{count}} contracts)
road.ending_empty_body: As soon as an active contract's end date falls within 60 days, it appears here.
road.ended_body: The end date has passed; nothing is invoiced any more. Read-only — a follow-up is a new contract.
road.ended_empty_body: A contract appears here by itself once its end date has passed.
road.cancelled_body: Cancelled contracts sit off the road; they are never invoiced.
road.start_draft: Contract {{no}} for {{customer}} is a draft without lines — put the first line in.
road.start_draft_read: Contract {{no}} for {{customer}} is a draft without lines — the company admin puts the first line in.
road.start_ending: Contract {{no}} for {{customer}} ends on {{date}} — decide the follow-up.
road.step_teach_draft: Draft: nothing is invoiced yet. Put the lines in, then activate.
road.step_teach_active: Active: this contract is invoiced per period; a change goes through a new revision.
road.step_teach_ending: Ending: decide the follow-up — a new end date, or let it end. Invoicing then stops by itself.
road.step_teach_ended: Ended: the end date has passed, nothing is invoiced any more.
road.activated_title: Contract {{no}} is active — from now on it is invoiced per period.
road.activated_body: Nothing has been sent. The invoices appear as drafts under Invoices; you check and send them there.
road.line_added_next_draft: Nothing is invoiced yet. Next: activate the contract once it is complete.
road.line_added_next_active: The line counts from the revision it sits on.
how.1: A contract is what a customer pays on a fixed basis, per building.
how.2: A line is one service, one amount, one period.
how.3: Activate starts the invoices on the billing day — a draft invoices nothing.
how.4: Revisions change amounts from a date without touching the past.
how.5: Lines can run as recurring work — the visits become tickets.
road.what_activate: Starts the invoices on the billing day; the past is untouched.
road.what_cancel: Stops new invoices; the invoices already made stay. Cancelled is final.
